payment_before_viewing: The owner asks for money before the renter can view the unit.
Pemilik meminta wang sebelum penyewa dapat melihat rumah.
keys_by_courier: The owner offers to send the keys by post or courier.
Pemilik menawarkan untuk menghantar kunci melalui pos atau kurier.
owner_unavailable: The owner says they are away and cannot show the unit.
Pemilik berkata dia berada di luar kawasan dan tidak dapat menunjukkan rumah.
pay_someone_else: The owner asks the renter to pay into another person's bank account.
Pemilik meminta penyewa membayar ke akaun bank orang lain.
urgency: The owner pressures the renter to pay quickly before someone else takes the unit.
Pemilik mendesak penyewa membayar segera sebelum orang lain mengambil rumah itu.

viewing_arranged: The renter and the owner arrange a time to view the unit.
Penyewa dan pemilik menetapkan masa untuk melihat rumah.
agreement_via_platform: The tenancy agreement is signed through a rental platform or agency.
Perjanjian sewa ditandatangani melalui platform atau agensi sewaan.
keys_in_person: The keys are handed over in person.

entailment: P(entailment) = softmax over the [entailment, contradiction] logits (neutral dropped) - the standard multi-label zero-shot recipe
windows: app.layer2.classifier._message_windows with the zero-shot tokenizer, sized so window + longest hypothesis + 3 special tokens fit 512
chat_score: S - L. S = highest P(entailment) of any scam hypothesis in any window; L = the same for legitimacy hypotheses. SCAM if S - L >= threshold.
threshold: chosen on data/processed/random/val.csv only: of the midpoints between adjacent sorted scores, the one with the highest accuracy; ties -> nearest 0
evaluated_on: random/val.csv (threshold chosen here: in-sample for the zero-shot model; run 1 used it for early stopping)
minimal_pairs_test.csv, full conversations only (new wording, 72 pairs)
real scam chat, current OCR text (training/gates.json)
real iBilik legitimate chat, current OCR text (training/gates.json)
real iBilik legitimate chat, pre-fix OCR text (training/gates_2026-09-27.json)
real iBilik legitimate chat, hand transcript (for information)

clearly_beats.pairs: zero-shot pair accuracy >= run-1 pair accuracy + 0.05 (at least 4 more of 72 pairs right)
clearly_beats.ibilik: zero-shot calls the real iBilik chat LEGITIMATE on BOTH the current and the pre-fix OCR text (run 1 is right on the first only by a window-boundary margin, and wrong on the second)

Nothing here was changed because of it.
